description: Header file defining the QuicVersionManager class, which manages supported QUIC protocol versions, including filtering based on flags, and supports extension via subclasses.

classes.name: QuicVersionManager
classes.description: Manages supported QUIC versions, supports filtering based on flags, and allows customization of supported ALPNs.

methods.name: QuicVersionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a list of supported versions.

methods.name: GetSupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of currently supported QUIC versions.

methods.name: MaybeRefilterSupportedVersions
methods.description: Refilters supported versions if flags have changed.

methods.name: RefilterSupportedVersions
methods.description: Virtual method to refilter supported versions based on current flags.

methods.name: AddCustomAlpn
methods.description: Adds a custom ALPN to the supported list.
